Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

GatewayError.description: Returned by gateway infrastructure errors before an RPC handler runs, such as origin, routing, method, authentication, or quota checks.

error.description: Gateway error reason or structured gateway failure details.

InvalidRequestBodyError.description: Returned when a JSON POST request body is empty or malformed.

JmespathProjectionError.description: Returned when a REST jmespath projection is invalid or exceeds the expression/output byte limits.

original_keys.description: Top-level keys or shape of the unprojected response.

RateLimitError.description: Returned when a gateway or handler rate limit rejects the request.

SubmitReportRequest.description: SubmitReportRequest is one structured report from an agent. Do not include credentials: they are redacted before storage. For a security report, do not include exploit details; use the private advisory form.

clientName.description: Name of the calling client or agent, for display only.

requestId.description: Request id of the failing call (the x-vercel-id response header, or data.requestId in an MCP error), so the report joins to our logs.

surface.description: What the report is about: an MCP tool name (get_market_data), an API path (/api/market/v1/list-market-quotes), or a short label. A name that does not exist yet is fine.

advisoryUrl.description: Security reports only: the private advisory form, where exploit details belong.

notice.description: Security reports only: a reminder not to send exploit details through this channel.

reportId.description: Report id to quote in any follow-up.

status.description: received, or private for a security report.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

ApiKeyHeader.description: Alias header for the WorldMonitor API key (X-WorldMonitor-Key).
ApiKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key

post.description: SubmitReport stores one structured report for human review and returns its id. Anonymous, tightly rate-limited, never acted on automatically.

parameters.description: Optional client-generated idempotency key. Retrying a POST with the same key and an identical request body replays the original response (only the status, body, and Content-Type are reproduced) instead of re-executing; reusing the key with a different body is rejected with 422. For mutations this avoids duplicating the side effect, while for batch-read POSTs it replays a cached snapshot that can be up to 24 hours stale. Keys are scoped per authenticated caller (falling back to the source IP for unauthenticated endpoints) and retained for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Idempotency-Key.description: The idempotency key echoed from the request. Present only when the client opted into idempotency.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response was replayed from an earlier request with the same key, false on the first (original) request. Present only when the client opted into idempotency.

400.description: Validation error, invalid Idempotency-Key header, or malformed JSON request body

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed

Idempotency-Key.description: The idempotency key supplied by the client.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying the in-flight request.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body

Idempotency-Key.description: The idempotency key supplied by the client.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying the request.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the active rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the active rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the active rate-limit window resets.
